title: SPH Fluid Simulation
description: An interactive particle-based fluid simulation built on the custom engine, using Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics, spatial neighbor search and parallel computation to model density and pressure in real time.

title: Physics & Simulation Engine
description: A custom C++20 engine for building interactive two-dimensional simulations, featuring a fixed-timestep application loop, batched OpenGL rendering, spatial data structures and real-time debugging tools.

title: Microservices Platform
description: A distributed software platform exploring microservice architecture, service communication and scalable application design.

title: Electric Charge Simulator
description: Interactive simulation of electric charges and their behavior through computational modeling.

description: An interactive environment for exploring neural networks and their behavior through visual experimentation.

title: Personal Inventory Manager
description: A web application for organizing and managing personal inventory.
